newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Dividend payment seen for CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Dividend payment seen for CANTV.

text.p: Venezuelan national telephone company CANTV may bring forward expected dividend payments to this year from 1998, a high placed company source said.

Having paid-off $127.8 million in debts with a recent $200 million Yankee bond placement "restrictions on the company paying out dividends have been lifted," said the source who asked not to be identified.

However: "we still don't have the company's audited results, which will be discussed February 25. Depending on those we may decree a dividend if there's profits ... I have a feeling there will be," added the source.
Late last year, Financial Officer Andres Glusky said the company expected to pay out a 12.5 percent cash dividend in 1998, contingent on paying-off debt and achieving sustainable earnings in 1997.

The company reported 1995 inflation-adjusted net profits of 14 billion bolivars versus a 11.7 billion billion bolivar loss in 1994. CANTV's fiscal year ends December. Results for 1996 are expected in March.
